description: How the whole business is doing, exactly as Home shows it: Home's verdict sentence first, then results in the business's own word (leads, sales, calls…) over the last 28 full days against the 28 before, the cost per result, this month's spend against the budget, results per week, and which campaigns work best and least (over their last 30 days).

language.description: Answer language. The business's language by default.

name: get_results

best.description: Campaigns over their synced last 30 days (campaigns have no daily rows).

anyOf.description: Over the same 28 days, in `currency`; null with no results (never read as 0).

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).

resultWord.description: What one result is for this business, plural, in the answer language (leads, sales, calls…).

results.description: Results (the business's own result word, `resultWord`) in the last 28 full days, the window Home shows.

resultsKnown.description: False when the 28 days have no results, so there is no cost per result.

scope.description: Always the whole business, all accounts together.

kind.description: early, new, few, lag, good, bad, mixed or same.

line.description: "How are we doing?" in one plain sentence, as the owner's Home says it.

window.description: The days `results` covers (ending yesterday, Israel's day) and the days before.

title: Results this month
